Gitboard serves as a local code-change dashboard for GitLab and GitHub, providing developers with a centralized view of CI status, open merge requests, and failed job triage. By integrating with local tools like `gh`, `glab`, and `git`, it bridges the gap between remote forge activity and local worktree state, facilitating efficient context switching and task management.
